crossRefs.note: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…
Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

people.name: Shelumiel
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Simeon

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

people.name: Zurishaddai
people.line: Father of Shelumiel, leader of Simeon

translations.web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translations.bsb: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
translations.kjv: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translations.asv: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
